tools.name: check_auth_status
tools.description:
Check if Spotify authentication is set up and working.

Returns current user info if authenticated.

tools.name: get_top_artists
tools.description:
Get your top artists based on listening history.

Great for understanding your music taste and finding festival lineups.

time_range.description:
Time period:
- "short_term": Last 4 weeks
- "medium_term": Last 6 months (default)
- "long_term": All time

tools.name: get_top_tracks
tools.description: Get your top tracks based on listening history.

time_range.description:
Time period:
- "short_term": Last 4 weeks
- "medium_term": Last 6 months (default)
- "long_term": All time

tools.name: get_recently_played
tools.description: Get your recently played tracks.

tools.name: get_followed_artists
tools.description: Get all artists you follow on Spotify.

use_cache.description: Use cached data if available (faster, default True)

tools.name: get_saved_tracks
tools.description:
Get all your liked/saved songs on Spotify.

Note: This may take 1-2 minutes for large libraries (10k songs).

use_cache.description: Use cached data if available (faster, default True)

tools.name: get_library_artists
tools.description:
Get unique artists from your saved songs, sorted by song count.

This shows artists you have saved songs from (even if not followed),
ranked by how many songs you've saved.

tools.name: get_albums_by_song_count
tools.description:
Find albums where you have N or more saved songs.

Great for finding albums worth buying on vinyl!

min_songs.description: Minimum saved songs to include album (default 6)

tools.name: export_library_summary
tools.description:
Export a complete summary of your Spotify library.

Includes:
- Followed artists
- Top artists by saved song count
- Albums with most saved songs

tools.name: follow_artists
tools.description: Follow artists on Spotify.

artist_ids.description: List of Spotify artist IDs to follow

tools.name: unfollow_artists
tools.description:
Unfollow artists on Spotify.

For safety, returns a preview unless confirm=True.

artist_ids.description: List of Spotify artist IDs to unfollow

confirm.description: Set to True to actually unfollow (default False for preview)

tools.name: save_tracks
tools.description: Save tracks to your Spotify library (like/heart them).

track_ids.description: List of Spotify track IDs to save

tools.name: unsave_tracks
tools.description:
Remove tracks from your Spotify library.

For safety, returns a preview unless confirm=True.

track_ids.description: List of Spotify track IDs to remove

confirm.description: Set to True to actually remove (default False for preview)

tools.name: search_track
tools.description: Search for a single track and get matches with confidence scores.

tools.name: search_track_fuzzy
tools.description:
Broader fuzzy search when exact match fails.

Tries multiple strategies:
1. Exact title + artist
2. Title only
3. Simplified title (removing parentheses, etc.)

tools.name: batch_search_tracks
tools.description:
Search for multiple tracks with confidence scoring.

Categorizes results:
- HIGH (>= 90%): Safe to auto-add
- MEDIUM (70-89%): Should review
- LOW (< 70%): Needs attention
- NOT FOUND: No results

delay_seconds.description: Delay between API calls (default 0.2s for rate limiting)

tools.name: get_track_preview_url
tools.description: Get the 30-second preview URL for a track.

tools.name: create_playlist
tools.description: Create a new Spotify playlist.

tools.name: add_tracks_to_playlist
tools.description:
Add tracks to an existing playlist.

Handles batching automatically (Spotify max 100 per request).

tools.name: create_playlist_from_search_results
tools.description: Create a playlist from batch search results.

include_confidence.description:
Which confidence levels to include:
- "high": Only >= 90% matches (safest)
- "high_medium": >= 70% matches
- "all": All matches (use with caution)

tools.name: import_and_create_playlist
tools.description:
Full workflow: Parse song list CSV, search all tracks, create playlist.

This is the main tool for bulk playlist creation from a list of songs.

csv_content.description: CSV content with columns: title, artist

tools.name: add_reviewed_tracks
tools.description:
Add tracks from a reviewed CSV to an existing playlist.

Use this after reviewing uncertain matches from a batch search.

The CSV should have an 'action' column:
- 'approve': Add the matched track
- 'reject': Skip this track
- spotify:track:xxx: Use this specific URI instead

tools.name: get_playlist_info
tools.description: Get information about a playlist.

tools.name: get_playlist_tracks
tools.description: Get all tracks from a playlist.

tools.name: export_playlist_to_csv
tools.description:
Export a playlist to CSV format.

Great for backing up playlists or sharing song lists.

tools.name: compare_playlists
tools.description: Compare two playlists to find shared and unique tracks.

tools.name: find_duplicate_tracks
tools.description: Find duplicate tracks in a playlist.

tools.name: remove_duplicate_tracks
tools.description:
Remove duplicate tracks from a playlist, keeping the first occurrence.

For safety, returns a preview unless confirm=True.

confirm.description: Set to True to actually remove duplicates

tools.name: remove_tracks_from_playlist
tools.description:
Remove specific tracks from a playlist.

For safety, returns a preview unless confirm=True.

track_uris.description: List of Spotify track URIs to remove

confirm.description: Set to True to actually remove

tools.name: reorder_playlist_tracks
tools.description: Move tracks within a playlist.

range_start.description: Position of first track to move (0-indexed)

tools.name: parse_song_list_csv
tools.description:
Parse a CSV of songs into a structured list.

Use this to validate your CSV before batch searching.

tools.name: export_review_csv
tools.description: Export medium/low confidence matches to a CSV for human review.
